candidate_windows.window_text: To perform the stimulus-tuning, we select training samples that consist of non-overlapping sequences of 80 consecutive words. We train the models with a batch size of 32 and for 2 epochs and we saved checkpoints of the models for each batch. The stimulus text is divided into 4 consecutive sections to enable cross-validation. For each GPT-2-based models we stimulus-tuned four models, one for each held-out run. We train the models using the default hyperparameters provided by Huggingface. As mentioned in Section 2.5 we selected the checkpoint for the stimulus-tuned model that best satisfies $\delta^{stim} \approx \delta^{base}$ .
